step.name: KTP name match
step.what_happens: Crew checks that the name on the original ID matches the ticket holder and that the photo matches the visitor.
slow_when: The ID is deep in a wallet or a bag.
The name on the ticket has a different spelling.
The visitor first shows a photo of the ID on a phone.
rules: Only original physical IDs are accepted.
A visitor aged 12 to 16 shows the companion's ID and ticket.

exceptions.what: Someone redeems for the buyer and brings the proxy documents.
The name does not match and there are no proxy documents.
The visitor has no original ID.
A minor arrives with a companion whose ID and ticket must be checked too.
